B001_out_buffer.rationale: np.add(out=...) requires an explicit output-buffer contract.

B002_where_preserves.rationale: np.multiply(where=...) requires an explicit masked-write contract.

B003_unsafe_cast.rationale: np.add(casting=...) requires an explicit casting contract.

B014_overlapping_alias.rationale: Overlapping in-place aliasing is not equivalent to allocating a fresh result.

B011_nan_inf_extrema.rationale: AsNumpy exposes both APIs, but fmax follows aclnnMaximum NaN propagation instead of NumPy fmax ignore-NaN semantics; contract review is required.

B016_reverse_strides.rationale: signbit is host-assisted and not strict-NPU qualified; negative-stride execution remains a runtime contract limitation.

B018_signed_zero.rationale: signbit is host-assisted and copysign does not preserve NumPy signed-zero semantics on the pinned runtime.

categories.contract_limited: The compute API exists, but keyword/signature, aliasing, or in-place semantics require an explicit contract decision.
categories.covered_compute: All compute calls are on the pinned AsNumpy public catalog or a documented D2 equivalence.
categories.multi_gap: Multiple missing compute APIs or multi-stage dataflow make this unsuitable for the first single-gap sweep.
categories.official_gap: An official alias/composition or exact-call contract is not yet admitted by the pinned catalog/overlay.
categories.out_of_scope: Dynamic execution, I/O, callbacks, special/object dtypes, threading, or external code; retained only for static refusal regression.
categories.single_gap: One primary missing compute API is isolated in an otherwise small program; G retains the same category while testing deduplication.
